memories.label: La maison de ma grand-mère / My grandmother's house

gist.fr: L'été de mes huit ans, la maison de ma grand-mère dans un village au pied des Alpes : la table sous le tilleul, le carnet où je dessinais des plans de cabanes, le bruit de la rivière le soir.
gist.en: The summer I was eight, my grandmother's house in a village at the foot of the Alps: the table under the lime tree, the notebook where I drew plans of huts, the sound of the river at night.

label.fr: la maison de ma grand-mère, au pied des Alpes

memories.label: Les années d'agence / The agency years

gist.fr: Quatre ans dans une agence digitale à Lyon, de 24 à 28 ans : des interfaces lourdes livrées trop vite, des nuits de recette, et la conviction, lentement, que le web pouvait être plus léger.
gist.en: Four years at a digital agency in Lyon, from 24 to 28: heavy interfaces shipped too fast, late nights of testing, and the slow conviction that the web could be lighter.

memories.label: Le premier matin dans l'atelier / The first morning in the studio

gist.fr: Le premier matin dans mon atelier face au parc, à 28 ans : la lumière sur le bureau vide, le carton de l'agence pas encore ouvert, le silence après quatre ans d'open space.
gist.en: The first morning in my studio facing the park, at 28: light on the empty desk, the box from the agency still unopened, the silence after four years of open-plan offices.

memories.label: La rencontre avec le Martien / Meeting the Martian

gist.fr: Un soir de mars, à 29 ans, sur le quai de Saône : un Martien, grand, calme, qui m'a demandé le chemin du musée des Confluences comme si c'était la chose la plus normale du monde. On a marché une heure. Il voulait comprendre pourquoi nos écrans sont si lourds.
gist.en: A March evening, at 29, on the Saône embankment: a Martian, tall and calm, who asked me the way to the Confluences museum as if it were the most ordinary thing in the world. We walked for an hour. He wanted to understand why our screens are so heavy.

images.prompt: Change ONLY two things in the first image: (1) the alien's head becomes the head of the Martian in the second image — a smooth bright green, rounder bald head, big black almond-shaped eyes, pointed ears, a small nose and a small mouth, on a normal neck; (2) his shoes become the dark boots of the third image. His silver jacket and trousers, his pose, the glowing phone, the woman, the embankment, the river, the buildings and the blue-hour lighting stay exactly identical.

memories.label: Le rêve des moutons électriques / The electric-sheep dream

gist.fr: La nuit qui a suivi la rencontre, un rêve : un pré au-dessus de Lyon, des moutons dont la laine clignotait doucement comme des diodes en veille, et moi qui essayais de les compter sans jamais arriver au même nombre.
gist.en: The night after the encounter, a dream: a meadow above Lyon, sheep whose wool blinked softly like standby LEDs, and me trying to count them without ever reaching the same number twice.

label.fr: le rêve est venu la nuit suivante
label.en: the dream came the following night

images.prompt: Close-up of the face of one of the sheep of the reference image, on the same grassy hillside above the blurred city lights at night, the other sheep softly glowing behind it exactly as in the reference: an ordinary, gentle sheep's face looking at the viewer. It is electric only in a subtle way: faint halos of light glow from INSIDE its flesh and wool, as if small electric organs shone through the skin — a soft diffuse pale-blue and amber bloom under the cheeks and inside the ears, a quiet inner light in the eyes. No dots, no LEDs, no garlands, no circuit lines, nothing stuck on the skin. Same painterly dreamlike style, hazy edges, muted colours, soft focus.
